title: Effective gluing of augmented module complexes
statement: For strict augmented complex gluing data [def-weil-pbc-augmented-module-complex-glue-data] on a small ringed site $(C,J,R)$, assume the object family $U:A\to C$ covers the site. There exist a global module cochain complex $K$, a map $\epsilon:K\to B$, and chain isomorphisms $e_i:K|_{U_i}\simeq L_i$ with $e_i\alpha_i=\epsilon|_{U_i}$.

proof.text: Apply the compatible-tuples construction degreewise. The transition/differential equations define the global differential and its square-zero equation is tested on every component. Local graph evaluation is a chain isomorphism.

The local augmentations give a map to the compatible tuples for B. Its diagonal from B is an isomorphism, since it is locally an isomorphism on the given cover. Compose with its inverse. The local augmentation equation follows componentwise.
